description: Stored error text (WatchEntity.lastError, watched address lastError) -> short technical code without hosts, URLs or addresses (Android StoredError.kt / iOS StoredError.swift). Markers stay, HTTP status (+ retry-after) stays, rate limit / timeout / offline become fixed codes, everything else ERROR or ERROR:<ExceptionName>. The refresh classification (RefreshReportLogic.classify) of input and output must be equal. input null -> null.
